selection_reason: CSW-03 completed_verified in PR #425. CSW-01, CSW-02 and CSW-03 now satisfy CSW-04 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects CSW-04 before CSW-05 and APM-03.
objective: Define optional Guided Creation Workflows that help novice creators reach coherent usable drafts for common storycraft tasks while expert creators can bypass, reorder or customize guidance without losing capability, authority separation, provenance, Personal/Campaign visibility safety or freeform creative control.
completion_gate: Novice users can reach a coherent usable pre-authoritative draft through optional guidance, while expert users can bypass, reorder or customize guidance without losing capability; all outputs remain attributable, visibility-safe and subject to explicit owning-domain incorporation.
required_design_questions: What reusable workflow/step/question primitives can serve many creator tasks without hard-coding one creative method?
How can creators skip, revisit, reorder, pause, branch or abandon guidance without losing work?
How do guided workflows coexist with direct freeform editing and CSW-03 Inspiration tools?
What common workflow families are in the initial bounded set: backstory, NPC/antagonist, faction, settlement/location, World/culture, mystery, adventure/quest, encounter, Campaign premise/arc?
Which fields/questions are universal versus task-specific and optional?
How are answers stored as Creative Fragments/Project Memory rather than prematurely becoming governed truth?
How does existing Story Bible context inform suggestions without creating circular truth or hidden-information leakage?
How do creator-owned reusable templates/presets work without granting publication/canonical authority?
How are optional AI suggestions inserted at individual steps without controlling the workflow or auto-applying output?
What accessibility/mobile/nonvisual behavior is required for progress, branching, reordering and validation?
preserved_parallel_tracks: APW-05 remains later in the approved sequence
next_action: Execute CSW-04 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining the reusable guided-workflow framework, initial task families, optional/skippable/revisitable steps, freeform escape and branching, Story Bible/Inspiration integration, reusable templates, optional AI step assistance and accessibility/mobile parity.
